requirements.label: Geography Year 1 school-certificate route
requirements.details: For the listed Year 1 route: MSCE, equivalent O-level, IGCSE or GCE with six credits including Geography, Mathematics and English, plus three other subjects. Examples of the other subjects are Biology, Physics, Chemistry, Computer Studies, Agriculture and Social Studies; not every example is compulsory. requirements.details: At least four years of work experience in a fashion- and arts-related field. The shared two-year mature-entry standard must not reduce this programme-specific minimum.

profiles.notes: Mature-entry source: headers/announcement say 2026/2027 but the opening body says 2025/2026; the applicability year remains unspecified. These are programme-specific routes within the shared mature-entry framework, whose diploma/post-diploma-work baseline is recorded once in the university-wide undergraduate other-entry scope. Some rows expressly offer school-certificate, A-level, certificate or professional alternatives; their interaction with the generic baseline requires confirmation, not an assumed waiver. No current open round, guaranteed placement, minimum age or IB/AP conversion is inferred.

requirements.label: Film Production diploma and school credits
requirements.details: Four MSCE/equivalent credits including English and at least a diploma related to Film, Drama, Arts or Humanities. The mature table lists full-time Year 3.

requirements.label: Chemistry, Physics and Electronics six-credit science list
requirements.details: For Chemistry (Honours), Physics and Electronics, the rows require six MSCE/equivalent credits and print English, Mathematics, Physical Science, Physics, General Science and Chemistry together. The source does not explain whether overlapping science qualifications are substitutes. All printed names are retained; applicants must confirm the acceptable combination rather than relying on an invented OR rule or a reduced subject list. Course-specific diploma major/classification and placement are recorded separately.

requirements.label: Named Family and Consumer Science mature route; catalogue link unresolved
requirements.details: The printed Bachelor of Science in Family and Consumer Science (BSCFCS) row requires four MSCE credits including English and three science subjects, plus a recognized Home Economics diploma or related diploma (examples Community Health, Nutrition, Family Studies, Early Childhood Development or Education), with full-time Year 2 or 3 listed. The previous economic call names Family Sciences (UNIMA-SCIFC); equivalence is not established. This named condition is retained in the university-wide scope rather than creating a possible duplicate award or silently attaching it to Family Sciences.

requirements.label: Alternative qualification routes versus generic mature baseline
requirements.details: The generic diploma and two post-diploma work years do not explicitly explain the separately listed school-certificate/A-level Geography and Geology routes, A-level Statistics group, Actuarial professional groups, UNIMA Computer Science certificate, ECD certificate, non-diploma Music alternatives or the two Diploma awards. These rows are preserved individually without promising baseline exemptions or requiring every alternative qualification together. Applicants must confirm which shared conditions apply to their exact route. This clarification does not replace stronger, expressly printed programme work requirements.

profiles.notes: Named Diploma in Statistics (DIPSTA) and Diploma in Music (DipMUS) conditions only; these are not bachelor's awards or universal requirements for all other-level study. The source does not establish a formal qualification-framework level, so no undergraduate/graduate classification or duplicate bachelor's programme is manufactured. Cycle labels are inconsistent and the generic mature diploma/work interaction needs confirmation. Read each fact only for its named diploma.

requirements.label: Diploma in Statistics certificate, work and school-credit wording
requirements.details: DIPSTA lists Year 2 by two-week block release. Its sentence names holders of a relevant post-secondary certificate with at least two years of work experience and holders of MSCE/O-level/IGSCE/GCE or equivalent with at least four credits including Mathematics and English. The printed and does not unambiguously establish whether these are separate applicant groups or cumulative credentials. Both parts are preserved without an invented OR, automatic waiver or a new bachelor's award.

requirements.label: Diploma in Music four-credit option
requirements.details: The first OR-separated DipMUS route is at least four credits at MSCE or equivalent O-level, IGCSE, GCSE or GCE. The table lists full-time Year 1. This paragraph does not separately publish a music-theory certificate, experience or audition condition; the interaction with the generic mature-entry baseline remains unresolved rather than borrowing the next options' conditions.

source.title: Malawi mature-entry specification, PDF page 15; DipMUS; inconsistent cycle labels

requirements.label: Diploma in Music Grade 3 theory option
requirements.details: Alternative DipMUS route: minimum MSCE or equivalent O-level/IGCSE/GCSE/GCE plus at least Grade 3 music theory from ABRSM, Trinity College London, Royal College of Music, Guildhall School of Music, London College of Music or UNISA. This is OR-separated from the four-credit and practical-experience routes, not an additional credential required from all applicants.

source.title: Malawi mature-entry specification, PDF page 15; DipMUS; inconsistent cycle labels

requirements.label: Diploma in Music experience and audition option
requirements.details: Alternative DipMUS route: minimum MSCE or equivalent O-level/IGCSE/GCSE/GCE and at least two years of proven practical music-industry experience, followed by an audition before admission. The named audition areas are instrument, ear training, music production, composition, sight reading or directing; the list does not make every audition area compulsory. Unlike the BMUS track-record routes, this paragraph does not offer a portfolio as an automatic substitute for the audition.
